title: Chidiya Tapu - The Sunset Paradise and Birdwatcher's Haven in Andaman
content:
Chidiya Tapu,

Chidiya Tapu, often referred to as the "Bird Island of Andaman," is one of the most picturesque destinations near Port Blair. Located at the southernmost tip of South Andaman Island, this tranquil paradise is known for its spectacular sunsets, rich biodiversity, dense mangrove forests, and scenic coastal landscapes.

The destination is a favorite among nature lovers, photographers, birdwatchers, and travelers seeking a peaceful escape from the bustling tourist spots. With breathtaking ocean views and lush greenery, Chidiya Tapu offers a perfect blend of relaxation and adventure.

History of Chidiya Tapu

Historically, Chidiya Tapu remained a relatively untouched region of the Andaman Islands due to its dense forests and remote location. Over time, it gained popularity among tourists because of its extraordinary bird population and stunning natural beauty.

The area has become an important eco-tourism destination, attracting visitors interested in wildlife conservation, birdwatching, and nature photography. Today, Chidiya Tapu is recognized as one of the best places in the Andaman Islands for experiencing untouched tropical landscapes.

Why Visit Chidiya Tapu?

Chidiya Tapu is famous for:

  • Magnificent sunset views
  • Rich birdlife and biodiversity
  • Dense mangrove ecosystems
  • Peaceful beaches
  • Scenic photography opportunities
  • Nature trails and trekking routes
  • Serene coastal environment

It offers a refreshing contrast to the water sports-focused attractions of Andaman.

Major Attractions in Chidiya Tapu

1. Chidiya Tapu Sunset Point

The biggest attraction of Chidiya Tapu is its breathtaking sunset viewpoint.

As the sun slowly disappears into the Bay of Bengal, the sky transforms into shades of orange, pink, and purple, creating one of the most spectacular sunset experiences in the Andaman Islands.

Photographers and nature enthusiasts often gather here during the evening hours to capture the magical scenery.

2. Birdwatching Paradise

The name "Chidiya Tapu" literally means "Bird Island."

The region is home to numerous bird species, including:

  • Andaman Drongo
  • Andaman Woodpecker
  • Emerald Dove
  • White-bellied Sea Eagle
  • Parakeets
  • Kingfishers
  • Sunbirds

The area is considered one of the best birdwatching destinations in the Andaman Islands.

3. Munda Pahad Trek

Adventure lovers can explore the famous Munda Pahad Trek.

The trail passes through:

  • Tropical forests
  • Coastal landscapes
  • Rocky cliffs
  • Scenic viewpoints

The trek culminates at Munda Pahad, offering panoramic views of the ocean and surrounding islands.

4. Mangrove Forests

Chidiya Tapu is surrounded by lush mangrove forests that play a vital role in protecting the coastal ecosystem.

These mangroves support:

  • Diverse wildlife
  • Marine species
  • Migratory birds
  • Ecological balance

The greenery enhances the area's scenic charm.

5. Chidiya Tapu Beach

The beach at Chidiya Tapu is known for its peaceful ambiance and picturesque surroundings.

Visitors can enjoy:

  • Relaxing walks
  • Photography
  • Nature observation
  • Coastal sightseeing

Although swimming is not the primary attraction, the beach offers excellent opportunities to unwind amidst nature.

Flora and Fauna

Chidiya Tapu is a biodiversity hotspot with abundant wildlife and plant species.

The area supports:

Bird Species

  • Andaman Bulbul
  • Drongo
  • Parakeets
  • Sea Eagles
  • Kingfishers

Marine Life

  • Crabs
  • Small reef fish
  • Coastal marine organisms

Vegetation

  • Mangroves
  • Tropical evergreen forests
  • Coastal plants
  • Native Andaman flora

Best Time to Visit

  • October to May: The ideal season for visiting Chidiya Tapu. The weather remains pleasant, and visibility for birdwatching and sightseeing is excellent.
  • November to February: Perfect for photography, trekking, and outdoor exploration.
  • June to September: Monsoon season brings lush greenery but may affect trekking activities.

How to Reach Chidiya Tapu

By Air

The nearest airport is Veer Savarkar International Airport in Port Blair.

By Road

Chidiya Tapu is located approximately 25-30 kilometers from Port Blair.

Travel options include:

  • Private taxis
  • Rental scooters
  • Tourist vehicles

The journey typically takes 45-60 minutes and passes through scenic forested roads.

Things to Do at Chidiya Tapu

  • Watch the Sunset: Experience one of the most beautiful sunsets in the Andaman Islands.
  • Go Birdwatching: Observe rare and endemic bird species.
  • Trek to Munda Pahad: Enjoy a scenic trek through forests and coastal trails.
  • Photography: Capture stunning landscapes, wildlife, and sunset views.
  • Explore Nature Trails: Walk through tropical forests and mangrove ecosystems.

Travel Tips

  • Visit during late afternoon to enjoy the sunset.
  • Carry binoculars for birdwatching.
  • Wear comfortable walking shoes.
  • Bring insect repellent.
  • Carry drinking water and snacks.
  • Avoid littering and respect wildlife habitats.

Nearby Attractions

Popular places often combined with Chidiya Tapu include:

  • Cellular Jail
  • Corbyn’s Cove Beach
  • Wandoor Beach
  • Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park
  • Samudrika Marine Museum
excerpt: Chidiya Tapu is a scenic nature destination near Port Blair, renowned for its spectacular sunsets, rich birdlife, and lush mangrove forests. Popular among photographers, birdwatchers, and trekkers, it offers breathtaking coastal views and peaceful natural surroundings. The destination is considered one of the best eco-tourism attractions in the Andaman Islands.
